page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores running on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture and a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing capabilities, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, fall into the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance metrics, including stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core scores, consistently align with mid-range industry averages. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached reads and writes also demonstrate average performance, supporting steady multi-threaded execution.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2.3xlarge is its modest single-core execution speed, which limits its effectiveness for single-threaded or latency-sensitive tasks. However, its dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer stable resource density for multi-threaded workloads. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance provides a predictable resource profile for general-purpose workloads that can leverage parallel processing. It is suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis databases, and moderate software compilation tasks.
